title: Chapter 2738: Supporting Xu Jiaqi
content:
Chapter 2738: Supporting Xu Jiaqi

"You want to participate in the Heavenly Star-Chasing Marathon? It’s meant for the younger generation, you know. Why would you want to take part in something like that?" Xu Jiaqi asked.

The Heavenly Star-Chasing Marathon was intended for talented cultivators of the younger generation to showcase their abilities. However, now that Xu Jiaqi knew Yuan was the reincarnation of Tian Yingzhe, she could no longer view him as someone belonging to that generation.

"I need the Boundless Spirit Dew, which is apparently one of the rewards. If you can get me one, I’d be more than happy to skip the race," Yuan explained.

"The Boundless Spirit Dew, huh? That’s unfortunate. If it were any other treasure, Bai Ling probably wouldn’t have any trouble giving it to you. However, the Boundless Spirit Dew is not only a priceless treasure from the Primordial Era, but it was also donated as a reward for the race, so it doesn’t actually belong to him," Xu Jiaqi said, shaking her head.

"It’s fine. Can you tell me more about the race instead?"

"All I know is that it’ll be one of the biggest events in recent history, and that the participants will have a limited time to race around the Ninth Heaven. If you want more details, you’ll have to speak to Bai Ling."

Liu Yucang then said, "I know that some of my recruits plan on participating in the race as well. If you want me to, I can tell them to assist you during the race to give you a higher chance of winning."

"I also know some members who want to participate!" Qiang Qing Yun quickly said. "Just give me the word, and I’ll ensure your victory!"

Hearing that, Yuan asked with a smile, "Is that even allowed?"

But before they could respond, Yuan continued, "Regardless, I appreciate the thought, but I don’t need your help. If I can’t win the race with my own strength, then I don’t deserve the reward."

"Are you sure? You’re still only at the 3rd level of God Ascension, and even though this event is meant for the younger generation, there are no age restrictions, meaning that anyone can participate, and with the Boundless Spirit Dew being a highly sought-after treasure, there will be many people going after it," Xu Jiaqi said.

Yuan chuckled and said, "Don’t judge a book by its cover. My cultivation may seem weak, but I can handle all three of you at once if I go all out."

"?!?!"

The three Celestial Overlords’ eyes widened at Yuan’s outrageous claim. Although they couldn’t fathom how someone at his level could possibly defeat three peak God Ascension cultivators, none of them questioned him, as they knew he wasn’t the type to lie about such things.

"Alright, I’ll be taking my leave now. See you later. If you need to speak with me, I’ll be at Gates of Heaven until the end of the race."

Once Yuan left the room, the three Celestial Overlords remained behind, staring at one another in awkward silence as though none of them knew how to proceed.

Even though Yuan had told them to work together, the change was far too sudden. After all, they had spent tens of thousands of years competing against one another for the position of leader in the faction.

"I know my father trusts both of you, but it’ll take some time for me to get used to this..." Xu Jiaqi eventually said.

"Me too," Qiang Qing Yun said. "To make things less awkward between us, how about we talk about our relationship with Senior Tian—and how we each got to where we are now?"

Xu Jiaqi nodded. "That’s a good idea."

"Who wants to go first?" Liu Yucang asked.

"Since you asked, you’ll go first," Qiang Qing Yun said.

"..."

After a moment of silence, Liu Yucang let out a deep sigh before revealing his history with Tian Yingzhe.

"My parents died when I was young, and I was taken in and raised by bandits. I spent many years living among them and became quite successful, but eventually we chose the wrong target, and most of us were wiped out."

"I was barely clinging to life when I encountered Senior Tian. He not only saved me, but also gave me a new purpose. After that, I joined the military and slowly worked my way up until I eventually entered the faction."

"A bandit? How lowly..." Qiang Qing Yun shook her head. "You’re making it difficult for us to trust you."

"I-I was young and uneducated, okay?!"

"That doesn’t make it better."

"Well, it’s not like I can go back in time and fix it."

"Whatever." Qiang Qing Yun then said, "In my case, my birth family was embroiled in an all-out war with another family. I won’t go into the reason behind it, but it ended with my family’s defeat. All of the men were killed, and the women were going to be sold to the highest bidder. But right before it could happen, Senior Tian saved us from a future I don’t even want to imagine."

"..."

Neither Liu Yucang nor Xu Jiaqi had anything to comment on Qiang Qing Yun’s background.

After a moment of silence, Xu Jiaqi spoke, "I don’t really remember how it happened, but I was on the verge of death when I met him, and after being healed, I asked to follow him. He was reluctant at first, but my stubbornness won. Ever since then, I’ve followed him everywhere, learning everything I could from him. At first, our relationship was more like master and disciple, but I ended up seeing him more as a father figure."

After sharing their stories, the three Celestial Overlords chatted a little more before gathering their members and announcing some breaking news.

"Starting today, I will be stepping down from the power struggle to support Senior Sister Xu," Qiang Qing Yun announced to her followers, leaving them speechless.

Liu Yucang followed, "I will also stop fighting for the faction leader’s position to support Senior Sister Xu."

"WHAT?!?!?!"
